correctness.rationale: For n>=2R+3, R>=2, 0<p<1, conditioning on a maximal r-run partitions second s-run starts into coincident, two touching and n-r-s-3 independent classes. This yields Cov(C_r,C_s)=n(delta_rs a_r+a_r a_s(2/q-r-s-3)). Normalization gives I+(2/q-3)vv^T-vw^T-wv^T; independent v,w and the nonzero determinant of its 2x2 coefficient matrix prove rank exactly two, with exceptional eigenvalues from trace tau and negative product -Delta. Zero plus the e_r attainable count vectors prove positive definiteness; geometric sums yield the stated limiting eigenvalues. Independent exact word enumeration checked 68 covariance entries. The argument is an all-admissible-parameter proof, not extrapolated from finite tests.
residual_risks: Outside n>=2R+3, wraparound can alter the formula; no central limit law or unscaled eigenvalue result claimed.
